name: standup
about: The daily standup (docs/phases/08-orchestrator.md, piece 6; docs/decisions/2026-10-18-standup.md): at 09:00 New York, loopd posts it in #loop-digest from the @orchestrator app, composed from the store: merged in the 24 hours to 09:00, in flight with its stage and age, waiting and on what, what needs the user, what the orchestrator did and its own spend (its turns against the cap, claude's cost and tokens). The stack starts at 09:00, which only starts the clock; the next 09:00 posts it, once that day. The 4-hourly digest no longer lists the items, it counts them.
